//: Season -> period-correct equipment.
Equipment lives in the save's CharacterVisuals table, not the Player
table. See docs/Schema.md Group 6 for the decode.
THREE RULES:
1. LINEAGE, NOT UNIFORMITY. A player's current helmet decides what they
move to -- by exact model where an era distinguishes them (byModel),
otherwise by manufacturer (byBrand). Riddell's line splits in the
2000s: an Axiom wearer belongs in a VSR-4, a SpeedFlex wearer in a
Revolution. Brands that did not exist yet take the fallback.
2. MASKS FOLLOW POSITION. The game's own rosters put kicker cages on
kickers (92-98% of the time) and cages or heavy bars on linemen. A
shell whose per-role masks are unknown uses its default faceMask for
everyone, which is what happened before masks were position-aware.
3. NOTHING UNCONFIRMED IS EVER WRITTEN. Every asset name below has been
seen in a real export. A season no era covers changes nothing.
To add an era or a helmet: make the change in the community roster
editor for one player, export, diff, and read the asset names out. No
code change is needed -- see docs/Equipment_Demo_Spec.md for exactly
which players to change and why.
//positionRoles: Derived from the base save: over 12,156 players the game puts a kicker
cage on 92-98% of kickers and punters, an open two-bar on quarterbacks,
and cages or multi-bars on the line.

//: Riddell Revolution Speed and Schutt Air XP, both confirmed. Per-role
masks for these shells are NOT yet confirmed -- only the two-bar has
been demonstrated -- so every position currently gets it. Filling in
masksByRole here is the single highest-value demonstration left.
The Riddell Revolution arrived in 2002 and was worn by 83% of NFL
players by 2008, so it dominates the back half of the decade; the
VSR-4 it replaced was still common early on. Both were still in
college use through 2010 (the 2005-2010 concussion study compared
them head to head), which is why the split is by model rather than
by year: a SpeedFlex wearer -> Revolution, an Axiom wearer -> VSR-4.
PENDING: GearHelmet_VSR4's real asset name is unconfirmed, so the

through to the Revolution. Schutt's 2000s shells (Air Advantage,
DNA) are likewise unconfirmed; the Air XP is a late-2000s helmet so
it is defensible from about 2008, but not for 2000-2007.
